Monsoon Arrives in Parts of India Amid Heatwaves and Water Shortages

While parts of India are experiencing monsoon rains, bringing relief from heatwaves and low water reserves in some cities, other regions continue to swelter. The Indian Meteorological Department has issued forecasts for varying rainfall patterns across the country, with some areas expecting significant showers while others face continued high temperatures. The delayed monsoon has also led to adjustments like changes in school timings in heat-affected areas.
